metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Sample up to 2048 real-item embeddings, seed 42, excluding padding/reserved tokens. Map mean off-diagonal pairwise cosine to [0,1]; denominator k*(k-1). Higher indicates directional alignment, not measured recommendation diversity. Existing convention returns zero for at most two items.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_sample_count: Number of real-item embeddings sampled for the collapse probe; pairwise denominator is k*(k-1).
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative model score across valid training-loader positions in at most ten batches; positive, negative and sequence IDs must be nonzero. Larger means stronger sampled separation; denominator is valid_positions in the breakdown.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of the same valid training-position margins, index ceil(0.1*N); lower indicates weaker sampled separation. Null if N=0.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of the same N valid training positions whose sampled negative score exceeds positive score; lower is better. Null if N=0.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of the same N valid training positions with positive-minus-negative score below eps=0.5; lower indicates fewer small margins. Null if N=0.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Counts low-margin and wrong-rank valid training positions and their denominator. Item-category metadata is unavailable, so category lists remain empty; these lists are unrelated to dataset routing.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_frequency_b: Stratify the same sampled training positions by positive-item training-interaction frequency: 1-4, 5-19, 20+. Each stratum reports its position denominator, mean margin and negative-beats-positive fraction. Frequency is not exposure.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:execution_checks: First require exact equality between the independent maximum-nonzero-position gather and the actual module's _readout on the same captured feature tensor. Compare ModelView features and scores directly with the actual module. At atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4, additionally compare unpadded/left-padded features, individual/batched scores, repeated calls, reversed batch order, empty rows and BxLxK scoring. Observe nn.GRU receiving hx=None through a temporary hook. Actual-module prediction parity is distinct from exported-predictor parity, which remains null without its explicit adapter. Required failures disable temporal interpretation; checkpoints are unchanged. Restore all module training flags and Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG states in finally.

Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.population: First at most 200 eligible users in lexicographic str(user_id) order; serialized-ID collisions raise an error. Eligibility requires at least six real training interactions, valid IDs and at least 99 training-unseen real items. Target is the final training interaction; retain the latest width preceding items, requiring at least five. Selection is deterministic. Raw/prefix/retained lengths, truncation, selection order, category and exclusion counts are saved. Targets may have been used during fitting.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.candidates: Target first, followed by 99 unique uniform negatives excluding the complete unchanged training history. Freeze candidate identities/order across all conditions. Candidate stream is SeedSequence([42, stable_user_index, 100]); no official evaluation candidates or labels are read. Complement sampling or rejection sampling without replacement produces the same uniform design. Insufficient pools are excluded, never relaxed.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.interventions: Five independent uniform position permutations of all n real positions and five of the first n-1 positions with the final position fixed. Separate streams SeedSequence([42, stable_user_index, 200/201]). Each draw reads an unchanged original copy. Width, real positions, leading padding and duplicate multiplicities remain fixed. Primary means include identity and duplicate-induced unchanged inputs, with no redraws. Record permutation indices, changed-position counts/fractions, endpoint-identity changes and unchanged-input rates. Full-shuffle endpoint preservation has expectation m/n for endpoint-item multiplicity m; fixed-final expectation is one. Shuffling can cause distribution shift.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.ranking: Rank/HR are null unless ModelView supplies diagnostic_rank_helper(scores, target, candidates, k=10) and a nonempty diagnostic_ranking_rule from the pinned evaluator. Helper receives native-dtype scores and returns one-based rank and binary hit. No substitute tie rule is assumed. Diagnostic HR is not official validation HR.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.rank_damage: Perturbed rank minus intact rank; positive means damage. Average all five draws within each user, then users equally. Null without the pinned ranking adapter.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.hr_damage: Intact hit minus perturbed hit at ten; positive means damage. Average all five draws within each user, then users equally. Null without the pinned ranking adapter.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.scores_and_ties: Save native score dtype, candidate IDs, full float64-converted score rows, paired score differences and 99 positive-minus-negative margins per draw. mean_positive_negative_margin averages those 99 margins; target_highest_negative_margin subtracts the maximum negative score. score_rms_change is RMS paired score movement over all 100 candidates. Exact target-score ties exclude the target. Boundary-spanning ties have fewer than ten scores strictly greater than the tenth-highest value and more than ten at or above it. Supplementary near ties use absolute tolerance 1e-8 and never alter ranks.
Movies_and_TV:temporal_sensitivity.cosine_distance: One minus cosine between perturbed and intact final states after direct conversion to float64. Null when either norm is below 1e-8. Primary user means require every prescribed draw to be finite; partial-repeat averages are unavailable. State movement alone does not establish ranking damage.
